notes: File-level board: one node per SignatureVolatility .lean module.
Done = listed in VERIFIED and deps done and file contains no `sorry`.
Any `sorry` forces open/blocked regardless of VERIFIED.
Hard edge B→A: A imports B (direct, submodule files only; barrel omitted).
Drawn edges are transitively reduced; blocking still uses all direct imports.
Paper kit goals: ProlongedBrownianSetup.StratonovichOfBM, ItoCalculusKit.OfMathFin, PriceFiltrationSignatureSpace.OfMarket, GKWDecompositionSetup.OfPFS, TheoremA, TheoremB, TheoremC, TheoremD.
Blue = done (proved, counterexample or refuted; no sorry). Green = open. Grey = blocked. Counterexample / refutation labels are shown as text on the node.

nodes.label: TheoremC: refuted by CounterExample_TheoremC
nodes.detail: REFUTED (CounterExample_TheoremC, theorem_C_refuted := not_theorem_C): Black-Scholes is complete with any finite set of calls but has N*_S = infinity, so 'complete iff N*_S < infinity' fails. Also: depth is infinite in every non-degenerate model; Prop. 58 refuted. Paper kit / theorem goal.

nodes.label: CounterExample_TheoremC
nodes.detail: CounterExample_TheoremC (proved, not_theorem_C): Black-Scholes is complete on F^S_T (vendored MathFin martingale representation, F^S = F^W) for every finite strike set, while N*_S = infinity; so the paper's 'complete iff N*_S < infinity' is false.
